purpose: Teach: 気功/狂牛病/磁場/下水道/社会保険庁/地表/脱臼/精油

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者の希望に気功も医療チームで尊重します
lines.en: Ren — we do respect our patients' wishes regarding alternative therapies within the care team's oversight.
lines.style: Measured, direct delivery. Steady eye contact. Professional without coldness. Each phrase lands with quiet authority. No rush.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、狂牛病類縁疾患の鑑別を医療チームで進めます
lines.en: Yes — we're proceeding carefully with differential diagnosis to rule out prion-related conditions across the entire team.
lines.style: Patient, methodical tone. Slight emphasis on 「進めます」 — the work is already underway. Calm cadence, like explaining a known process to someone trusted.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、MRIの磁場安全管理を医療チームで徹底します
lines.en: Ren — MRI safety protocols around magnetic fields are something we take very seriously as a team.
lines.style: Calm, factual delivery. A small pause before 「徹底します」 to underscore thoroughness. Not defensive — just clear about standards.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、病院の下水道感染対策を医療チームで強化します
lines.en: Yes — we've strengthened our infection control measures throughout the hospital, including wastewater management protocols.
lines.style: Patient, steady. Matter-of-fact about infrastructure. No apology in the tone — just competent explanation of what's in place.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 社会保険庁の制度変更を、貴院、対応されてますね、先生
lines.en: I've noticed your hospital has adapted well to the recent changes in national insurance policy, Doctor.
lines.style: Respectful, genuinely curious. Soft opening — Ren's perceptiveness showing. Slight hesitation before 「対応」, not doubt but genuine interest in her response.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、地表の紫外線対策を医療チームで指導します
lines.en: Yes — we counsel patients on UV protection, especially for those with sun exposure risks, as part of our preventive care approach.
lines.style: Patient, practical tone. Warm without fussing. Explains the 「why」 behind the practice without being condescending. Professional but human.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、関節脱臼の整復を医療チームで丁寧におこないます
lines.en: Yes — we handle joint reductions with careful technique and full team coordination to minimize patient discomfort.
lines.style: Steady, reassuring delivery. Emphasis on 「丁寧に」 — precision and gentleness are non-negotiable. Composed, experienced.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 精油アロマテラピーを、貴院、補助療法とされてますね、先生
lines.en: I've heard your hospital integrates aromatherapy as a complementary approach — is that part of your standard care?
lines.style: Quiet curiosity, slightly tentative. Ren testing the waters, not challenging. Respectful attention to her answer. Soft pacing, genuine interest underneath.
